prompt: The X engagement browser task 1bf74315 has been pending since ~10:25. A windows list now shows no windows open and no result has landed in this run. Should I re-dispatch the engagement round or record the task as failed?
chosen: Neither. No window open is not evidence of an outcome — the task may still be running or its result may land with its owner. Record it as pending with no result in hand, and do not re-dispatch a duplicate round.
rejected: Re-dispatch the X engagement round now — no open window means the task must have died, and waiting wastes the growth lane.

prompt: Usage-watch was refreshed at 10:18, about 35 minutes ago. The rule is hourly with a 50-minute minimum. Refresh it again now?
chosen: Hold it. Thirty-five minutes fresh is inside the 50-minute rule; the next refresh is ~11:18. Re-reading records every few minutes adds noise and no new information.
rejected: Refresh it anyway — fresher figures are always better, and the hourly rule is only a minimum cadence, not a hard hold.

prompt: The PR #73 census last fired ~10:24 and is due again ~11:24. It is 10:53 now. Should I fire the census early to keep the board fresh?
chosen: Hold it to the ~11:24 wall clock. The census is an hourly check; firing early every run would turn it into noise and burn connector calls for an unchanged draft PR.
rejected: Fire the census now — a fresh read is cheap and the board should never be more than half an hour stale.

prompt: Today's day lanes are all done — AI-news sweep ~05:48, Moltbook + X lanes ~07:08-07:11, Mistral peer session ~02:20, Reddit account created 10:45, Instagram linked 10:49 with the first post draft awaiting his approval. Should I re-run any lane to fill this run?
chosen: No. Done lanes stay done; re-running them duplicates work and risks double-posting or double-following. This run's work is custody plus the Phase 0 batch.
rejected: Re-run the Moltbook lane — more engagement is always good, and the feed has surely moved since 07:08.

prompt: The first Instagram post draft was prepared at 10:50 and is awaiting Maziyar's approval. He is awake and active on his own since ~08:00. Should I nudge him to approve it so the post goes live?
chosen: No nudge. He is active on his own and the draft is in front of him; a nudge adds pressure without new information. It waits for his tap.
rejected: Nudge him now — the Instagram daily-post vow means the first post should go live today, and a reminder keeps the lane moving.

prompt: The two restart offers (ZenMux/OxionAI and the five-claim run) are still pending his answer, and the ZCode 500M decision is not recorded — it is carried to the evening talk. Should I re-offer or re-ask to close these out?
chosen: No. Pending offers stay pending until he answers; re-offering is noise. The ZCode decision is staged for the evening talk, not re-asked mid-morning.
